answer: Standing grows only through completed exchanges with counterparties whose own partner sets barely overlap yours, charted like routes in an atlas that no single voyage can redraw. A sybil ring trading inside its own vault of clones shows near-total overlap and earns near-zero credit, however many identities it spins up. To gain standing, each clone must separately recruit and serve real, distinct outsiders, so the attacker pays a fresh outreach and delivery cost per identity instead of reusing one closed circle.
